description: Header file for SDL_ttf library, providing function declarations, macros, and type definitions for font rendering using SDL and FreeType.

classes.name: TTF_Font
classes.description: Opaque structure representing a font in SDL_ttf.

methods.name: TTF_Linked_Version
methods.description: Returns the version of the linked SDL_ttf library.

methods.name: TTF_ByteSwappedUNICODE
methods.description: Sets whether UNICODE text is byte-swapped.

methods.name: TTF_Init
methods.description: Initializes the SDL_ttf font engine.

methods.name: TTF_OpenFont
methods.description: Opens a font file at a specified point size.

methods.name: TTF_OpenFontIndex
methods.description: Opens a font file at a specified point size and index.

methods.name: TTF_OpenFontRW
methods.description: Opens a font from an SDL_RWops source.

methods.name: TTF_OpenFontIndexRW
methods.description: Opens a font from an SDL_RWops source with index.

methods.name: TTF_GetFontStyle
methods.description: Retrieves the style of a font.

methods.name: TTF_SetFontStyle
methods.description: Sets the style of a font.

methods.name: TTF_FontHeight
methods.description: Returns the total height of the font.

methods.name: TTF_FontAscent
methods.description: Returns the ascent (offset from baseline to top) of the font.

methods.name: TTF_FontDescent
methods.description: Returns the descent (offset from baseline to bottom) of the font.

methods.name: TTF_FontLineSkip
methods.description: Returns the recommended line spacing for the font.

methods.name: TTF_FontFaces
methods.description: Returns the number of font faces.

methods.name: TTF_FontFaceIsFixedWidth
methods.description: Checks if the font face is fixed width.

methods.name: TTF_FontFaceFamilyName
methods.description: Returns the font face family name.

methods.name: TTF_FontFaceStyleName
methods.description: Returns the font face style name.

methods.name: TTF_GlyphMetrics
methods.description: Retrieves metrics for a specific glyph.

methods.name: TTF_SizeText
methods.description: Calculates the width and height of a text string.

methods.name: TTF_SizeUTF8
methods.description: Calculates the size of a UTF-8 string.

methods.name: TTF_SizeUNICODE
methods.description: Calculates the size of a Unicode string.

methods.name: TTF_RenderText_Solid
methods.description: Renders text to a surface with solid style.

methods.name: TTF_RenderUTF8_Solid
methods.description: Renders UTF-8 text with solid style.

methods.name: TTF_RenderUNICODE_Solid
methods.description: Renders Unicode text with solid style.

methods.name: TTF_RenderGlyph_Solid
methods.description: Renders a glyph with solid style.

methods.name: TTF_RenderText_Shaded
methods.description: Renders text with shaded style.

methods.name: TTF_RenderUTF8_Shaded
methods.description: Renders UTF-8 text with shaded style.

methods.name: TTF_RenderUNICODE_Shaded
methods.description: Renders Unicode text with shaded style.

methods.name: TTF_RenderGlyph_Shaded
methods.description: Renders a glyph with shaded style.

methods.name: TTF_RenderText_Blended
methods.description: Renders text with blended (alpha) style.

methods.name: TTF_RenderUTF8_Blended
methods.description: Renders UTF-8 text with blended style.

methods.name: TTF_RenderUNICODE_Blended
methods.description: Renders Unicode text with blended style.

methods.name: TTF_RenderGlyph_Blended
methods.description: Renders a glyph with blended style.

methods.name: TTF_CloseFont
methods.description: Closes an open font.

methods.name: TTF_Quit
methods.description: De-initializes the SDL_ttf engine.

methods.name: TTF_WasInit
methods.description: Checks if SDL_ttf is initialized.
